Verify Goals table/list section renders correctly. If list is empty: confirm empty state message appears (e.g. 'No goals created yet. Click "Create Goal" to get started'). Verify no orphaned loading spinners or broken layout.

Test goal progress recording. Locate the goal created in step 4 in the table. Click the 'Progress' button or action on the goal row. A progress recording modal or form should appear. Enter a progress value (e.g., 25) and submit. Verify PATCH /api/v1/goals/{goal_id}/progress returns HTTP 200. Verify the goal row now shows updated progress. Note: full goal field editing (title, description) is via progress updates, not a separate edit modal. PASS if progress recording works correctly.

Navigate away from the department detail panel by clicking the back button or clicking another menu item (e.g., 'Dashboard'). Wait 2 seconds. Close the detail panel. On the departments list page, verify the list is still populated and no stale data is shown (no deleted departments still visible). Using browser DevTools or page.evaluate(), trigger a simulated timeout on the next API call by waiting 35+ seconds (or use page.evaluate() to mock a slow response).
